turn.user_message: Do we need to hire anyone?
turn.context: Prompt 1 of bm-pr-07 (and bm-so-04). bed-management.md §7.4.4: the Bed Manager on any one of three triggers (₹4 to 4.5 lakh), Admissions Executives sized by the peak hour (₹3 to 3.5 lakh each), scope added for everyone else. Transcript 22 and 28: two managers as peers, three on the afternoon desk, ₹17 to 19.5 lakh, Discharge Executives not yet sized.

transcript.label: After transcript turn 31 · Processes, turn 8 (the record stops at 31)

text: Two managers, and three people on the afternoon desk. The discharge desk is sized once we have your times.
bullets: A Bed Manager owns the plan from the OPD slip to the bed. Two of the three triggers are met on your numbers.
A Discharge Manager owns each discharge, so the plan runs on real times. Neither manager reports to the other.
Three Admissions Executives cover your afternoon peak. One person handles about 5 admissions an hour.
chat.invite: Next, we can see how you would know it is working.
prompts: How would we know it is working?
Can someone we already have do this?
Why not one manager for both?

reports_to.name: Head of Operations
reports_to.does: Both managers report here, as peers.

roles.name: Bed Manager
roles.does: Owns the bed plan, from OPD slip to bed. Runs the 2 PM and 6 PM plans.

triggers.label: Over half of admissions run late

roles.name: Discharge Manager
roles.does: Owns each discharge, so the bed plan runs on real times, not guesses.

roles.name: Admissions Executives
roles.does: Run the desk through the afternoon peak. One person handles about 5 an hour.
roles.note: Sized on your busiest hour, not the minimum cover.

roles.name: Discharge Executives
roles.does: Sized once we know when your discharges happen through the day.
roles.note: Not in the cost yet, on purpose.

blocks.others: OPD, Medical Supervisory, the desk and Billing each record a little more. That is a wider job, not a new one.

sheets.title: Bed Manager
sheets.text: Owns the whole bed plan, end to end. Any one trigger is enough, and two are met on your numbers.
sheets.entry: Could someone you have take this role?

sheets.title: Discharge Manager
sheets.text: Makes discharge times something the bed plan can trust. A peer of the Bed Manager, not under it.

sheets.title: Admissions Executives
sheets.text: About 41 admissions a day, arriving over a short window. The busiest hour needs three people at 5 an hour each.

lines.label: Cost
lines.value: About ₹3 to 3.5 lakh each a year

sheets.entry: How many people are on the desk at 2 PM?

sheets.title: Discharge Executives
sheets.text: The usual rule says one for every 15 discharges a day. At another hospital the real answer was lower, once its busy hours were known.

lines.label: Need from you
lines.value: When discharges happen in a day

sheets.entry: When do most discharges happen here?

blocks.label: Cost of the new roles
blocks.sub: Two managers and three Admissions Executives. This is the full cost, not the extra cost, until we know who is on each desk today.
